scientific_question: Within a finite pure-endogenous Qwen2.5-7B WebShop budget, what qualified-success supply, task-identity diversity, and independent multi-rollout multiplicity exist for a later causal experiment?

upstream_audit.design_implication: Keep the existing WebShop runtime pinned; treat task diversity, adaptation method, and endogenous-success supply as competing hypotheses rather than assuming diversity is causal.

budget.parallelism: use only live-idle authorized UUIDs; recheck before each wave

qualification: identity_ok and description hash match and trace_complete and no parser_or_fallback_failure and error == null and final_task_score > 0

early_stop_sufficiency.action: seal the reservoir; do not replace unrun tasks or start training/evaluation

hard_boundaries: no copied trajectory counts as an independent rollout

selector_rules.C-D: feasible pooled diversity contrast requires >=16 qualified identities and >=32 records
selector_rules.C-M: upstream-informed method control requires >=8 multi-rollout-ready identities
selector_rules.C-BOTH: if both pass, select one by deterministic information-gain rule before a new preregistration
selector_rules.C-S: otherwise seal endogenous feasibility-negative; teacher route becomes eligible only under a new preregistration
